_llm_instructions: قم بتعبئة 'project_title' و 'date_prepared'، بالإضافة إلى خصائص 'value' لكل حقل في نموذج ميثاق الفريق هذا بناءً على سياق المشروع. السياق والتعريف: [ أضف السياق والتعريف هنا ] المحاذاة: [ أضف معلومات المحاذاة هنا ]

Team values and principles.guidance: List values and principles that the team agrees to operate within. Examples include mutual respect, operating from fact not opinion, etc.

Meeting guidelines.guidance: Identify guidelines that will keep meetings productive. Examples include decision makers must be present, start on time, stick to the agenda, etc.

Communication guidelines.guidance: List guidelines used for effective communication. Examples include everyone voices their opinion, no dominating the conversation, no interrupting, not using inflammatory language, etc.

Decision-making process.guidance: Describe the process used to make decisions. Indicate the relative power of the project manager for decision making as well as any voting procedures. Also indicate the circumstances under which a decision can be revisited.

Conflict resolution process.guidance: Describe the process for managing conflict, when a conflict will be escalated, when it should be tabled for later discussion, etc.

Other agreements.guidance: List any other agreements or approaches to ensuring a collaborative and productive working relationship among team members.
